senses.en: A place where ill or injured people receive medical treatment.

ex.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex.zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

ex.en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
ex.zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。

col: be admitted to hospital｜入院治疗
tip: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

senses.en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross.
A journey across water or another geographical barrier.

ex.en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。

ex.en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
ex.zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。

tip: 作名词可指过街地点，也可指乘船横渡的行程。

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex.zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

ex.en: Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
ex.zh: 驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。

tip: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

senses.en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.

ex.en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。

ex.en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
ex.zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。

col: an interesting finding｜值得关注的发现
find something interesting｜觉得某事有趣
tip: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

senses.en: Relating to Italy, its people, culture, or language
The main language spoken in Italy
A person from Italy

ex.en: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
ex.zh: 我们用番茄和新鲜罗勒做了意大利面。

ex.en: Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.
ex.zh: 研究意大利建筑可以帮助学生理解历史建筑如何影响当代城市设计。

tip: 国籍和语言名称首字母大写；意大利人复数为Italians。

senses.en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.

ex.en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。

ex.en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
ex.zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。

col: book a table at a restaurant｜预订餐馆座位
tip: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
ex.zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。

ex.en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
ex.zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

col: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨
tip: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

senses.en: a public road in a town, usually lined with buildings

ex.en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们穿过街道来到面包店。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 沿繁忙街道植树可以改善空气质量，让城市街区更适宜步行。

tip: street多指城镇中两旁有建筑的道路。

senses.en: To obtain or receive something.
To become a particular way.
To arrive at a place.

ex.en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
ex.zh: 我生日时收到了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.
ex.zh: 低收入家庭的学生可能难以获得完成大学课程所需的经济支持。

tip: 过去式got；美式过去分词也用gotten。

senses.en: a noticeable or important part of something
to include or present someone or something prominently
a part of the face, such as the nose

ex.en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
ex.zh: 这个背包最让我喜欢的特点是它的隐藏口袋。

ex.en: Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 在重视居民健康与福祉的城市中，公共公园是一项不可或缺的特色。

tip: 作动词时直接接宾语，不说feature with。

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
ex.zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

col: follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

senses.en: At, to, or over a great distance.
To a much greater degree.
More distant from you or a particular point.

ex.en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
ex.zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以让住在大城市中心以外的人通勤时省下很多钱。

tip: far可修饰比较级，如far better；不用far good。

senses.en: Give someone information or describe something in words.
Instruct someone to do something.
Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.

ex.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
ex.zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

ex.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
ex.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

col: tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事
tip: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

senses.en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
to transport people somewhere by bus

ex.en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束后，我们赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.
ex.zh: 增加公交班次可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善远郊居民的就业出行条件。

tip: by bus不加冠词；take a bus需加冠词。

senses.en: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine
a flat surface extending in every direction
to make wood smooth using a special cutting tool

ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

senses.en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey.
To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground.
A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.

ex.en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。

tip: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

col: slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

senses.en: Towards or in a lower place or position.
Along something, or from a higher to a lower point.
Feeling unhappy or discouraged.

ex.en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫从厨房的桌子上跳了下来。

ex.en: As housing costs go up, the amount young adults can save often goes down.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，年轻人能存下的钱往往会减少。

tip: down后接名词可作介词；feel down表示心情低落。

senses.en: A reduction in the speed of activity or growth

ex.en: Road repairs caused a slowdown on my journey home.
ex.zh: 道路维修让我回家路上的车速慢了下来。

ex.en: An economic slowdown can reduce job opportunities, particularly for young people entering the labour market.
ex.zh: 经济放缓可能减少就业机会，尤其影响初入劳动力市场的年轻人。

col: a slowdown in growth｜增长放缓
tip: slowdown是名词；动词短语写作slow down。

senses.en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening.
A place where buses or other vehicles regularly collect passengers.
An interruption of movement or a brief stay somewhere.

ex.en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
ex.zh: 雨越下越大，我们便停下了脚步。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。

col: stop someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
tip: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

senses.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
Before the expected time or near the beginning

ex.en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。

ex.en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
ex.zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。

tip: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

senses.en: A strong protective covering worn on the head

ex.en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
ex.zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
ex.zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

senses.en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement
used to express a confident conclusion
something considered essential

ex.en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
ex.zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: must have done｜想必已经做过
an absolute must｜绝对必需的事物
tip: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

senses.en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body
to damage or become damaged through repeated use
damage caused by regular use over time

ex.en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
ex.zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。

ex.en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
ex.zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。

tip: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.
Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。

ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

senses.en: a country in central Europe

ex.en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到德国去学工程了。

ex.en: Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 德国投资可再生能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: Germany是国名；German可指德语、德国人或德国的。

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

senses.en: A country in the northern part of Great Britain.

ex.en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。

ex.en: Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.
ex.zh: 苏格兰以壮丽的风景吸引游客，而乡村社区则受益于游客在住宿和当地服务上的消费。

col: the west coast of Scotland｜苏格兰西海岸
a trip to Scotland｜苏格兰之旅
tip: 苏格兰是英国的组成部分；形容词通常用Scottish。

senses.en: To go to see a person or place.
An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.

ex.en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
ex.zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。

ex.en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。

col: pay a visit to｜拜访；参观
a guided visit｜有导游陪同的参观
tip: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

col: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

senses.en: a large shop selling food and other everyday goods

ex.en: We stopped at the supermarket to buy milk and rice.
ex.zh: 我们顺路去超市买了牛奶和大米。

ex.en: Large supermarkets can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten independent shops in smaller communities.
ex.zh: 大型超市能提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁小型社区里的独立商店。

tip: 在超市购物常说shop at a supermarket。

senses.en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.

ex.en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
ex.zh: 我们做饭、听音乐，度过了这个晚上。

ex.en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
ex.zh: 晚间课程让在职成年人无需辞去现有工作，也能获得新的资格证书。

tip: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介词。

senses.en: during the evening or night of today
the evening or night of today

ex.en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。

ex.en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
ex.zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。

tip: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

senses.en: On the day after today.
The day after today, or the future more generally.

ex.en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们明天早上在游泳池见面。

ex.en: The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.
ex.zh: 今天作出的环境决策将塑造未来孩子们继承的世界。

tip: tomorrow前通常不加on；明早是tomorrow morning。

senses.en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations

ex.en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。

ex.en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
ex.zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。

tip: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: A unit of language with meaning.
A promise or assurance that someone gives.
To express something using particular language.

ex.en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。

ex.en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
ex.zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。

col: word a question carefully｜仔细斟酌问题的措辞
tip: keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
ex.zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。

ex.en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
ex.zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

tip: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

senses.en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject.
Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.

ex.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

ex.en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
ex.zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。

tip: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: To go from one place to another.
The activity of going to other places.
To move or spread from one place to another.

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。

senses.en: one of two equal parts of something
equal to one of two equal parts of something
to an extent that is not complete

ex.en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
ex.zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。

ex.en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。

tip: 复数为halves；“半小时”用half an hour。

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

tip: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues

ex.en: We're having a small get-together at our flat tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们要在公寓里办个小聚会。

ex.en: A regular neighbourhood get-together can strengthen social ties and help new residents feel more welcome.
ex.zh: 定期举办邻里聚会能加强社会联系，让新住户更有归属感。

tip: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。

senses.en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.

ex.en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
ex.zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。

ex.en: Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
ex.zh: 阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。

tip: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

tip: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: Taking long walks outdoors, especially in the countryside.

ex.en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
ex.zh: 我去远足时，这双靴子能让双脚保持干爽。

ex.en: Hiking offers an affordable way to improve physical health while encouraging people to appreciate natural landscapes.
ex.zh: 徒步旅行是一种经济实惠的健身方式，也能鼓励人们欣赏自然风光。

tip: 通常指乡野长途步行；也可作hike的现在分词。

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.en: A thought or suggestion about what to do.
A mental understanding or belief about something.
Some knowledge or understanding of a situation.

ex.en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
ex.zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。

ex.en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。

col: come up with an idea｜想出一个主意
tip: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
ex.zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
ex.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

ex.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

senses.en: To become a member or take part with others.
To connect things or become connected.
To go where someone is and spend time with them.

ex.en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
ex.zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

ex.en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
ex.zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。

tip: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

senses.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity
a place where people dance and socialise at night
a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
ex.zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。

ex.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: A person who works, especially for pay.

ex.en: A worker in orange overalls repaired the broken fence.
ex.zh: 一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。

ex.en: Employers should provide every worker with appropriate training and equipment to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当的培训和设备，以降低工伤风险。

tip: 不只指体力劳动者，也可指医护等职业工作者。

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

ex.en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
ex.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。

ex.en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
ex.zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。

col: work as a postman｜当邮递员
the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

senses.en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
ex.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

tip: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: The fisherman pulled his net onto the wooden boat.
ex.zh: 渔民把渔网拉上了木船。

ex.en: Each fisherman in the coastal village depends on healthy marine ecosystems to maintain a reliable income.
ex.zh: 这个沿海村庄的每位渔民都依靠健康的海洋生态系统来维持稳定收入。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

col: pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

senses.en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills
a comfortable bus used for longer journeys
to train or teach someone to improve particular skills

ex.en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
ex.zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。

ex.en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
ex.zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。

col: travel by coach｜乘长途客车出行
coach a team｜训练一支队伍
coach someone for an exam｜辅导某人备考
tip: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth
a large mass of similar things seen together

ex.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。

col: a sea of faces｜人头攒动
tip: at sea指在海上；by the sea指在海边。

senses.en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily.
To continue being in a particular condition.
A period spent living or visiting somewhere.

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。

ex.en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
ex.zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。

tip: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

senses.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

ex.en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在离家不远的一所大学读工程学。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应扩大接受大学教育的机会，避免有才华的学生因经济障碍被拒之门外。

tip: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。
